youtube_title: LPG Cylinder Accident? Oil Companies' Insurance Covers You. Rules You Didn't Know #22 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #22. An accident with the gas cylinder: damage at home and a hospital bill. A: you pay for everything. B: the oil companies' insurance covers it. Comment!
Answer: B. Every LPG customer registered with the oil companies is covered by the insurance policy the oil companies take. As per the Ministry's reply in Lok Sabha (March 2023): death up to Rs 6 lakh per person, medical expenses up to Rs 2 lakh per person (Rs 30 lakh per accident), damage to the registered home up to Rs 2 lakh per accident. To claim, inform your gas distributor in writing right away; the distributor takes it to the oil company and the insurer. Policy terms can change year to year, so check with your distributor.
Sources: MoPNG reply, Lok Sabha Unstarred Q 2730 (16 Mar 2023); OMC LPG insurance policy.
